role: Generic readout of the actual paid segment already bounded by the original source-generated Completion receipt.
inputs: original Programme and original initial Frame
for receipt_read only: a proof that the supplied readout is stable under the same actual inr paid action
for receipt_environment only: the supplied initial environment function is actually constant (GenericEnvironment.At)
producer_chain: existing mathTarget_budget gives exact remaining(mathTarget event)=remaining(event.state)-1
the same actual source action at every offset<R must be inr paid because a settlement has remaining zero
prefix_budget proves remaining at the original frame(start+offset)=R-offset for offset<=R
receipt bound distance<=R and its actual settlement force distance=R
paid_at_offset and receipt_paid_prefix return Sigma actual GeneratedStepAt and PLift source action equality, directly by source action matching
receipt_read folds actual stable readouts through the same ordered finite prefix

receipt_interface.proof_method: Does not unfold or reimplement receipt recursion, does not alter Receipt data, and does not choose Type witnesses from Prop Exists.

direct_consumer.positive: Consumes the signed CP82 actual-paid-after-birth witness to prove positive source budget; the actual full Step in Type is then generated by receipt_paid_prefix at Fin offset zero.
direct_consumer.zero_control: Uses the original receipt actual atReceipt settlement, proves the next receipt distance zero, and directly retains original receipt_next and receipt_compiles. No terminal frame is supplied.
direct_consumer.environment: Direct receipt_environment consumption with the initial At witness.

scope: distance and budget are exact SourceOperationExecution.remaining AST mathematical costs. No bit cost, physical cost, extra strict payment, new root/controller, new actorClock, or world terminal is claimed.
